reliability_badges.cvd: Low reliability: image-only discriminative performance on systemic vascular disease is near chance (Test ROC-AUC: 0.5202 [0.3936, 0.6416]). Not a diagnostic test.
reliability_badges.dr: High reliability: direct ocular microvascular condition with 76.99% test accuracy on held-out test cohort.

disclaimers.prediction_note: Predictions are model-generated estimates from a research prototype and do not constitute a medical diagnosis.
disclaimers.cvd_warning: Retinal fundus images alone achieve near-chance discrimination for systemic cardiovascular disease. Attending clinician review, blood pressure check, lipid panel, and standard ECG are required.
disclaimers.dr_note: Diabetic Retinopathy (DR) grading reflects retinal microvascular findings only and does not establish systemic CVD status or a diabetes diagnosis.
